snippet.title: Vaultbreakers - Demo Launch Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Vaultbreakers: https://store.steampowered.com/app/306910/Vaultbreakers/

Vaultbreakers' demo is now available on Steam! 

Gather allies, grow your Haven, and jump into expeditions to break into your first Vault in the demo. Vaultbreakers is a top-down Extraction RPG where you go on PvE or PvPvE adventures. Use preparation, knowledge, and skills to clear your path to the Dragonvault. By the Developers of Forced and Minion Masters.

Vaultbreakers Store Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/306910/Vaultbreakers/

--

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more at https://iii-initiative.com
